title: Online MAP Enforcement: Evidence from a Quasi-Experiment
eligible_reason: Single-date design. The manufacturer's new MAP and dealer-agreement policies take effect at one date (post), and the DiD compares authorized with unauthorized retailers: areg vioRate authorized authXpost [controls] i.month_year, absorb(sku) cluster(retailerXSKU). Treatment authXpost = authorized x post has one adoption date; 'authorized' is a retailer-type main effect and the FE are SKU (not retailer-SKU unit) FE. Heterogeneity tables add triple interactions (top, service, distance, dual status, email notifications). No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata. data files/Tables.do produces Tables 1-5 from random5percent_data.dta (4,133 retailer x SKU x month observations).
data_provenance_note: README: 'a disguised random sample of 5% of the observations from the monthly full dataset'; point estimates differ from the paper.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). One policy date; disguised 5% sample.
